name: Civil unrest
summary: France braces for 5 Nov general strike after weeks of mass protests and arrests
state: French unions and all four major rail unions have called a general strike for 5 Nov after the government offered no concessions (Latin Times; Sortiraparis). About 410,000 marched on 24 Oct with 1,314 arrests and around 50 officers injured; no deaths have been reported. Indonesia deployed about 21,000 troops in Jakarta on 4 Nov, with no protests reported (AP).
for_you: Expect transport and school disruption in France on 5 Nov; check operators and FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Significant protests in several countries = Watch; no deadly nationwide unrest

sources.title: Latin Times — France protests: 410,000 marched, unions set November 5 general strike

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
